results.title: Rival Terror Groups Devastate the Sahel - Africa Defense Forum
results.snippet: JNIM and ISSP began fighting in mid-2019 and have engaged in around 320 battles that have killed more than 2,200 fighters, according to ACLED’s West Africa senior analyst Héni Nsaibia. Territorial battles had been confined to Burkina Faso and Mali but have expanded into Niger’s Tillaberi and Dosso regions and Nigeria’s Kebbi state since April 2026. results.title: JNIM and ISSP intensify clashes in northern Burkina Faso | UA.NEWS
results.snippet:
According to UN estimates, about 4.5 million people in Burkina Faso will need humanitarian assistance in 2026. The latest consolidated official estimate of internal displacement, published in March 2023, was approximately 2.1 million people. ACLED also recorded the spread of the confrontation between JNIM and ISSP to the Tillabéri and Dosso regions in Niger and Kebbi State in Nigeria.
